items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Collapsible nav rail, inset content panel and a header with breadcrumbs. Router agnostic: it takes a pathname and a link component, so nothing about it is tied to Next, React Router or any data layer. Install app-shell-demo alongside it for a runnable example with mock data.

items.name: app-shell-demo
items.title: App shell demo
items.description: A runnable back office screen built on app-shell: mock nav, a filterable table, stat cards and an activity feed. Install app-shell first.

items.name: project-showcase
items.title: Project showcase
items.description: A list of work where hovering a row floats a preview beside the cursor. One rAF loop writes the transform, so pointer movement never re-renders React; the preview trails because the loop lerps toward the pointer.

items.name: smooth-cursor
items.title: Smooth cursor
items.description: A drawn cursor that springs after the pointer, tilts into its direction of travel, squashes with speed and swaps to a hand over anything clickable. Position and angle are both springs integrated at a fixed 360Hz substep, so the motion is the same at 60Hz and 144Hz, and no React state is involved.

items.name: scroll-traced-rail
items.title: Scroll traced rail
items.description: A vertical rail that draws itself as its content scrolls past, for timelines and step lists. Stretches to any height without measuring, follows the theme, and draws in full under prefers-reduced-motion.
